report.explanation: Order checkout traces are healthy (70ms, OK) and order/gateway/inventory metrics are normal. Payment metrics show elevated p95 (1950ms) and slightly higher error rate (0.004), but no payment logs or traces are available to establish a bounded cause. The order deploy record alone cannot establish deployment-caused latency. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off for payment-side telemetry.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/traces to confirm whether the 1950ms p95 latency is real and where time is spent
Payment dependency timeout/error breakdown and downstream span data
Order-to-payment call latency breakdown to attribute checkout degradation
Baseline payment p95 latency to judge whether 1950ms is anomalous
